scoring_justification: Alpha recomputed from raw Sk_curves.csv using power-law fit on large-k tail; structural constraints for mass/surface fractals applied. Analytical relation checked by exact match against formula with ε=5.

outputs.description: Circularly averaged structure factor S(k) for each functionality distribution. The checker will recompute the power-law exponent α from this file and score against hidden gold.
Agent-reported scattering exponent α and its standard error for each distribution. The checker will compare these to hidden gold values from the paper.
Mean functionality ⟨n⟩ computed from the analytical formula for W=1,2,3,4 using ε=5. Values are exact and will be checked against precomputed gold.

output_contract.notes: The Sk_curves.csv file is the primary recomputed artifact driving the main scoring; the checker will independently fit α from this raw data. The alpha_distributions.csv file provides a self-consistency check between the agent's own fit and the recomputed α.
